title: My Son-In-Law Forged My Truck Title, Took $450K, And Left Me $4K. So I Let The Court Shame Him
description: After my son-in-law forged the title to our pierogi food truck, took a $450K buyout, and handed me $4,000 as a 'thank you', I exposed his forgery with a handwriting expert. Now the court orders him to serve 'Fraud Pierogi' in my truck, wearing a 'Dough Me Wrong' hat while customers scan his perjury conviction. #RevengeStory #PierogiJustice #CourtOrderedShame
thumb_text: FRAUD PIEROGI SERVED BY THE THIEF HIMSELF
pinned_comment: If your son-in-law forged the title to your food truck, took $450K, and thanked you with $4,000, what would you have done? Tell me your story in the comments.
